note: Ypres: Burgundian stone wall finished 1409, with bastions in front of the gates from the late 16th c.; Vauban's great works are later (1680s). The ring follows the moats and ramparts that survive in OSM (east and south) and the line of the Ieperlee (west); it matches the inner rampart on the Ferraris map (1777) within about 50 m.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Ieper' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140005)

gateSources.Menenpoort: OSM (site of the 1927 memorial); name in use in the 17th c. not verified
